Tomorrow, it will snow. We will make a snowman by the window. We will blow the snow to help it grow. His hat will be a bowl, and his arms will be arrows. We know the snowman can’t throw. It is just for a show! Mañana, va a nevar. Vamos a hacer un muñeco de nieve junto a la ventana. Vamos a soplar la nieve para ayudarlo a crecer.
